text: The BERTopic v0.17.4 official Code Overview presents a six-part topic pipeline: extract document embeddings, reduce dimensionality, cluster the reduced embeddings, tokenize topics, calculate class-based TF-IDF topic representations, and optionally fine-tune those representations. Its example uses Sentence Transformers, UMAP, HDBSCAN, CountVectorizer, and ClassTfidfTransformer for the first five stages.
